description: Na₄Mg(CoO₃)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one CoO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CoO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.84 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.53 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.49 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CoO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.08 Å. There are two inequivalent Co sites. In the first Co site, Co is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.83 Å. In the second Co site, Co is bonded to four O atoms to form CoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Co-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-2.00 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Mg, and one Co atom to form distorted ONa₂MgCo trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Mg trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Co₂ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Mg trigonal bipyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Co atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na and two Co atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to three Na and two Co atoms to form distorted ONa₃Co₂ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₄Mg trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₄Mg trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgCo trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to four Na and one Mg atom to form ONa₄Mg trigonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Co₂ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂MgCo trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Co₂ square pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂MgCo trigonal pyramid.
